text: すてみで　ぶつかって　いけ！

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form says the action carries on forward from now; いけ is the blunt order form. ぶつかって　いけ = 'go on and throw yourself at them'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells the way something is done. すてみで = 'by risking everything'.
